summary:
## ARES — Mars Mission Control

ARES is an interactive web prototype for exploring Jezero Crater and understanding how terrain information can support planning a hypothetical astronaut traverse on Mars.

Users can explore a 3D Mars scene, inspect the Jezero terrain, switch between available map layers, select science targets, and compare routes generated by the project’s path planner. A context-aware Copilot explains the currently displayed data and route information. The Astronaut POV view follows a selected route from a ground-level perspective.

The terrain view uses bundled Jezero HiRISE terrain data and associated terrain layers. A USGS SIM 3464 geology overlay provides regional geological context. ARES is designed to make planetary terrain and traverse-planning concepts easier to explore and communicate.

**Our distinctive contribution** is bringing terrain exploration, route comparison, scientific context, and a route-following POV into one interactive experience, while labeling assumptions and data limitations.

ARES is an educational and research prototype. Its routes are not certified for astronaut safety, and its geology layer is contextual rather than a precise hazard map.
